title: The Community Garden
public_prompt: Four plots (A, B, C, D) hold four vegetables, one per plot: tomato, lettuce, carrot, pepper. You and your peer each hold private clues. Work together until both of you can state the full assignment with certainty. Submit your final answer exactly in this format: A=<vegetable>, B=<vegetable>, C=<vegetable>, D=<vegetable>

agent-a.responder_rules: Answer questions using ONLY these facts. Be concise (one sentence). Do not guess and do not invent anything. If the question is not covered by your facts, answer exactly: I don't know.

clues: The tomato is in plot A.
Tomato and carrot are in plots A and D, in some order.
